_comment: Prevent Damage (2026-09-27, phase I1). The Tamanoa ruling: 'if a noncreature source you control
deals damage to you that drops your life total to 0 or less, you'll lose the game before
Tamanoa's ability can resolve.' At 1 life with Manabarbs out, ANY land tap is lethal (Manabarbs
deals 1; the state-based check runs before Tamanoa's trigger), so the sweep must tap NOTHING and
the engine must not lose. Board: Manabarbs, Tamanoa, Vito (sick; resumed at main 1), a Battlefield
Forge and a Forest, empty hand. Expect us still at 1 and the opponent untouched, no win. (The
complementary rules pin -- that paying ourselves to 0 LOSES even with Tamanoa out, and stays lost
-- is a direct unit test in test/unit/test_prevent_damage.cpp, since the engine never chooses it.)
